CruiseMapper currently has no ship schedule for Port Borkum Island (Germany)

Borkum Island (port locode DEBMK) is a municipality in Germany's Lower Saxony state (Leer District) with population around 5,000. The island is west of Juist Island (Niedersachsen's/ Lower Saxony's Aurich District) and east of Rottumeroog Island (Holland-owned uninhabited isle part of West Frisian Islands, Wadden Sea). Juist Island is located between three German islands - Borkum (west), Norderney (east) and Memmert (southwest).

Borkum has highest elevation point 6 m (20 ft), length 10 km (6 mi), max-width 7 km (4 mi) and total area approx 31 km 2 (12 mi2), making it the largest of Ostfriesische Inseln (East Frisian Islands). The island is bordered by the Westerems Strait (west, forms the Germany-Netherlands border), Osterems Strait (east), North Sea (north) and the Wadden Sea (south). Borkum was formed in 1863 by merging two isles previously separated by shallow water. The island's shape and position change due to the strong sea currents. Since the early-20th-century, people try to limit the sea impact (especially storm surges) through structural measures, particularly extensive bank reinforcements on the western coast - including 35 stone walls (groynes) and a beach wall (at Sudbad Beach).

As a cruise port, Borkum was included in the 2021 schedule of the TUI-owned German brand Hapag-Lloyd Cruises with the ships Hanseatic Inspiration (May 2021) and Hanseatic Nature (October 2021).

Driving cars on Borkum is permitted everywhere during the off-season, but during the summer, cars are not allowed in several zones. The island's only town is Stadt Borkum.

Crossings to mainland Germany and Holland are operated by regularly/daily scheduled ferries linking with Emden Germany and Eemshaven-Groningen Netherlands.

Borkumer Kleinbahn (railway) connects the yacht harbour/port (Borkum Reede) with Borkum Town. A signature tourist attraction is Gezeitenland (adventure water park with premium wellness facilities).

Booking.com has listed 109 hotels on Borkum Island, the best-rated and largest of which include Hotel Weisse Dune, Nordsee Hotel, Upstalsboom Seehotel, Strandhotel VierJahresZeiten, Rummeni, Bloemfontein (with horse stables), Strandhotel Hohenzollern, and Inselhotel VierJahreszeiten. Numerous smaller hotels, villas, apartments, guesthouses and B&Bs are also available for rent.
